For the first part:
\[
\frac1{x^2}\binom{7}{k}(-1)^k x^{14-2k}y^k
=\binom{7}{k}(-1)^k x^{12-2k}y^k.
\]
To get \(x^8y^2\), we need \(k=2\). Coefficient: \(\binom{7}{2}=21\).

For the second part:
\[
\frac3y\binom{7}{k}(-1)^k x^{14-2k}y^k
=3\binom{7}{k}(-1)^k x^{14-2k}y^{k-1}.
\]
To get \(x^8y^2\), we need \(k=3\). Coefficient: \(3\binom{7}{3}(-1)^3=-105\).

Total coefficient:
\[
21-105=-84.
\]

\[
\boxed{-84}
\]
